envelope.description: Give the feedback entry an anchor, a decision and a batch id, and add the batch append

body.title: Give the feedback entry an anchor, a decision and a batch id, and add the batch append
body.summary: Add the three optional fields to the entry's type, the stored list's schema, the append request's schema and coercion, the single-entry writer and the Feedback section renderer. Add appendFeedbackBatch (all entries in one write, or none) and priorFeedback (the stored list of an artifact JSON, or an empty list).
acceptanceChecks: An entry with an anchor, a decision and a batch id is accepted and stored by the single-entry append and by the batch
A request without the new fields is stored and rendered exactly as before
The batch writes every entry in one write, or nothing when one entry is invalid
The Feedback section shows an entry's decision and quoted text

tests.name: feedback: appendFeedbackBatch writes every entry in one write with ids and one timestamp, changes no other key, and writes nothing when any entry is invalid
feedback: appendFeedback stores an entry's anchor, decision and batchId when the request has them and stores a request without them exactly as before
feedback: the tool's input schema, coerceRequest and the stored list's schema accept an entry with an anchor, a decision and a batchId, and an entry without them is still valid
feedback: feedbackBodyLines shows the decision and the quoted text of an entry that has them and renders an old entry byte-identically
feedback: priorFeedback returns the stored list, and an empty list for a missing, unreadable or feedback-less artifact
